modos.descricao: Forca oponentes em combate a fugir, -2 Rage ate regen

_metadata.texto_original: The Gift user forces all opponents in combat against him to flee, ending combat. The targeted opponents act at -2 Rage until their next Regeneration Phase.
_metadata.notas: fugir + modificar_atributo. 'ate_regen' pode precisar de implementacao no motor.
